description:
The Tracepanel agent: it keeps the traces, finds the issues and serves the console. One executable per
    platform, its classifier the platform: darwin-arm64, darwin-x64, linux-arm, linux-arm64-gnu, linux-arm64-musl, linux-ia32-gnu, linux-ia32-musl, linux-ppc64-gnu, linux-riscv64-gnu, linux-s390x-gnu, linux-x64-gnu, linux-x64-musl, win32-arm64, win32-ia32, win32-x64.
